end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting everyday waste and linking clean habits with school safety and care for plants. Anika identified banana peel as wet waste, and paper and pencil shavings as dry waste, explaining that composting needs air for microbes. They mixed up plastic wrappers with compostable waste; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise sorting a few kitchen items into wet, dry, and plastic waste.
